query: insert into public.artists (name, slug) values ('نورا الورد','nورا-الورد'), ('سليم ناصر','salim-nasser'), ('ليان صبري','layan-sabri'), ('يوسف مراد','youssef-mourad'), ('رنا حبيب','rana-habib'), ('آدم ربيع','adam-rabie') on conflict (slug) do update set name = excluded.name; insert into public.songs (title, normalized_title, slug, artist_id, provider, provider_video_id, opaque_token_hash, status) select v.title, v.normalized_title, v.slug, a.id, 'demo', v.provider_video_id, v.opaque_token_hash, 'active' from (values ('ليلة هادئة','ليله هادئه','layla-hadia','نورا الورد','demo-layla','c2ec799e4cd80b2425d391a25fddd7f499b0c143f19768540c8d8694e9f31dc7'), ('بين الغيم','بين الغيم','bayn-al-ghaym','سليم ناصر','demo-cloud','bbc555f67e63d31572244cdf6d278bb433a20b772ef09c772ab112f15f3ff28c'), ('أثر الورد','اثر الورد','athar-al-ward','ليان صبري','demo-rose','a28f32549f22e9dd6716717aca004195cfbf82afb665250c8af79166f1e70156'), ('على مهل','على مهل','ala-mahal','يوسف مراد','demo-slowly','9a0f17cc1e191a4971b4cb82d187d6ca568d2c946c9a06cdcbc80f14a7d6f14b'), ('صوت المدينة','صوت المدينه','sawt-al-madina','رنا حبيب','demo-city','b71285cda3a89af0b84db716fde255b8644ba68d154862746a34daf7e182556b'), ('موجة خفيفة','موجه خفيفه','mawja-khafifa','آدم ربيع','demo-wave','e5bdbfb1fcdf5005f29b8d4cdf654a12448807999e0cce0dde221786ecdb16ac')) as v(title, normalized_title, slug, artist_name, provider_video_id, opaque_token_hash) join public.artists a on a.name = v.artist_name on conflict (provider, provider_video_id) do update set title = excluded.title, normalized_title = excluded.normalized_title, slug = excluded.slug, artist_id = excluded.artist_id, opaque_token_hash = excluded.opaque_token_hash, status = 'active';
